<!--
Table S7: percent change in 2036 relative to the base scenario for the twelve individual strategies (20% change), by prescription opioids (Rx), illegal opioids (IO) and all opioids combined.
Run from this folder. Reads Vensim results from results/ or this folder; writes to "figures and tables/".
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(svglite)

results_dir <- "results"
# The .cmd files write their CSVs to the project folder; use results/ if the file was moved there
find_result <- function(f) if (file.exists(file.path(results_dir, f))) file.path(results_dir, f) else f
figures_dir <- "figures and tables"
dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r settings}
level <- "20"
var_lookup <- tribble(
  ~variable,                   ~Outcome, ~Substance,
  "Noise PWURx NP",           "PWUIO-RxNP", "Rx",
  "Noise NDHU",                "PWUIO-RxNP", "IO",
  "Pol total PWURx NP and NDHU", "PWUIO-RxNP", "All opioids combined",
  "Noise Rx OUD",              "OUD",    "Rx",
  "Noise HUD",                 "OUD",    "IO",
  "Pol total UD",              "OUD",    "All opioids combined",
  "Noise Rx death",            "Death",  "Rx",
  "Noise synth death",         "Death",  "IO",
  "Pol total death",           "Death",  "All opioids combined"
)
outcomes <- var_lookup$variable

strategy_labels <- c(
  "DivRxInit"   = "(1) Reduce diverted Rx initiation",
  "HInit"       = "(2) Reduce heroin/illegal synthetic opioid initiation",
  "OwnRxInit"   = "(3) Reduce Rx use in a manner other than directed",
  "RxRate"      = "(4) Reduce number of people who receive Rx",
  "DevOUD"      = "(5) Reduce opioid use disorder development",
  "ReturntoOUD" = "(6) Reduce return to opioid use disorder",
  "PeerRec"     = "(7) Add peer recovery reinforcing loop",
  "FentODRisk"  = "(8) Reduce overdose risk with fentanyl",
  "NxKits"      = "(9) Increase distribution of Nx kits",
  "ODwitnessed" = "(10) Increase probability of OD to be witnessed",
  "TxSeeking"   = "(11) Increase treatment seeking",
  "TxDuration"  = "(12) Increase treatment retention"
)
```

```{r read-helper}
# Read one Vensim sensitivity CSV (one row per posterior draw; columns "T<k> <variable>",
# T0 = 2009) and return long format: sim_run, year, variable, scenario, value
read_long <- function(file, scenario, outcomes) {
  dt   <- fread(find_result(file))
  cols <- grep(paste0("^T\\d+ (", paste(outcomes, collapse = "|"), ")$"), names(dt), value = TRUE)
  if (length(cols) == 0) stop("No outcome columns found in ", file)
  dt   <- dt[, ..cols][, sim_run := .I]
  long <- melt(dt, id.vars = "sim_run", variable.name = "temp_col", value.name = "value")
  long[, `:=`(year     = 2009L + as.integer(str_extract(temp_col, "(?<=^T)\\d+")),
              variable = str_remove(temp_col, "^T\\d+ "),
              scenario = scenario)]
  long[, .(sim_run, year, variable, scenario, value)]
}

# Percent change of each run relative to the base run, matched by posterior draw
pct_change_summary <- function(runs, base) {
  pct <- merge(runs, base[, .(sim_run, year, variable, base_val = value)],
               by = c("sim_run", "year", "variable"))
  pct[, pct_change := 100 * (value - base_val) / base_val]
  pct[year >= 2024,
      .(mean_pct_change = mean(pct_change),
        lower           = quantile(pct_change, 0.05),
        upper           = quantile(pct_change, 0.95)),
      by = .(scenario, year, variable)]
}
```

```{r read-data}
base <- read_long(sprintf("Pol_Base_singles%s.csv", level), "Base", outcomes)
runs <- rbindlist(lapply(names(strategy_labels), function(s)
  read_long(sprintf("Pol_%s_sens%s.csv", s, level), s, outcomes)))

pct <- merge(runs[year == 2036], base[year == 2036, .(sim_run, variable, base_val = value)],
             by = c("sim_run", "variable"))
pct[, pct_change := 100 * (value - base_val) / base_val]
```

```{r table-S7}
table_S7 <- pct %>%
  inner_join(var_lookup, by = "variable") %>%
  group_by(scenario, Outcome, Substance) %>%
  summarize(mean_pct = mean(pct_change),
            lower    = quantile(pct_change, 0.05),
            upper    = quantile(pct_change, 0.95), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(value    = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)", mean_pct, lower, upper),
         Strategy = factor(strategy_labels[scenario], levels = strategy_labels),
         Outcome  = factor(Outcome, levels = c("PWUIO-RxNP", "OUD", "Death")),
         Substance = factor(Substance, levels = c("Rx", "IO", "All opioids combined"))) %>%
  select(Strategy, Outcome, Substance, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Substance, values_from = value) %>%
  select(Strategy, Outcome, Rx, IO, `All opioids combined`) %>%
  arrange(Strategy, Outcome)

knitr::kable(table_S7)
fwrite(table_S7, file.path(figures_dir, "Table S7.csv"))
```
